question: What claim about scope is at stake in referring to the whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: There are earth-moving yoginīs and sky-moving yoginīs.
Together they form a single field-group.
inference: The teaching concerns the complete field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The structure of that field-group is not detailed here.
plain_english: The whole field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
